name: Bath & Body Works
verdict: Brief carried FY25 data; FY26 Q2 net sales $1,514M −2.3%; null-gate mechanism; GAAP>adjusted inversion confirmed.

court_record.dd_opus: 5.5/10 BUY-STARTER: 12.5% capital-return cash cow, floor $15, venue-bear refuted
court_record.lean_red_team: REJECT AS FRAMED — Finding 1 (refuted): FY26 guide verbatim 'no share repurchases assumed'; Q1 buyback $0; $289M went to DEBT PAYDOWN; committed return = 3.5% dividend only. Finding 2: the GAAP $0.90 = interchange settlement ($0.43) + tax true-up ($0.31); clean adjusted EPS $0.32, DOWN 35% YoY. Finding 3: FCF ~$740M normalized -> ~$535M underlying guide = the floor is real but ERODING (52wk low $14.16 already probed it). Finding 7: September-class capital — no December vol event, 3.5% carry doesn't pay for the tax window.
court_record.adjudication: REJECT accepted. Re-submittable only as the honest thin version: ~9x declining EPS + 3.5% qualified div + de-levering credit + buyback-resumption OPTION ≈ 2.5-3/10 at one-third size — not investable for the current goal. FLIP CONDITION: a buyback re-authorization + a Circana print showing candle/body-care share stabilizing — BOTH, then re-underwrite.

venue_screen_feedback: second consecutive long-side death for the venue detector (BBW: plateau+CEO exit; BBWI: capital-allocation facts) — the doctrine holds: venue quality is FLOOR calibration, never long generation

edge_explainer.market_believes: A fading mall brand with a candle problem — 7 holds, no sells, nobody excited at 9x.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The market's actually about right: the stores are fine (off-mall migration executed — our census verified it) but the earnings are falling, the buyback is switched off in favor of debt paydown, and the committed return is just the 3.5% dividend.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: None today — our own red team killed the pitch. The prepared edge is the flip condition: buyback re-authorization PLUS category share stabilizing = the cash-cow thesis becomes true at what would likely still be a single-digit multiple.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: Consensus-fair: the +12% YTD already reflects the clean beat; dead-money risk is the base case.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Q2 print Aug-27 (comps + any capital-return language); any buyback re-authorization 8-K.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Two more quarters of candle/body-care share loss = the category bear confirmed = drop the watch entirely.
edge_explainer.edge_type: flip-condition watch; alert $18 (the add-zone the dead thesis wanted — only live if BOTH flip conditions fire first)

reopen_gates: price ≤$15.00 (≥15.5% recurring FCF yield) OR Q3 10-Q US/Canada store sales decline narrowing to ≤−2% with 39-wk OCF ex-refund annualizing ≥$550M FCF → 1/3 sleeve
